title: In OpenStack keystonemiddleware before 13.0.3, by supplying a malicious regular expression when creating an…
description: OpenStack keystonemiddleware versions before 13.0.3 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user can supply a malicious regular expression in an application credential access_rules entry. This can cause resource consumption in the process handling the request, potentially making the service unresponsive. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 4.3 and does not impact confidentiality or integrity but affects availability.
